title: Quantum Foundations, Qubits & Decoherence
description: Explore quantum superposition, entanglement, superconducting qubits, and quantum error mitigation.

questions.question: What fundamental quantum property allows a 'qubit' to represent both 0 and 1 states simultaneously until measured?
What phenomenon occurs when the quantum state of two or more particles cannot be described independently of each other?
Why do many superconducting quantum computers require dilution refrigerators cooled near absolute zero (~15 millikelvin)?
options: To prevent thermal noise from causing quantum decoherence in fragile qubits
To save electricity during peak computational hours
To freeze liquid nitrogen into crystalline conductors
To prevent fiber optic cables from melting under laser power

questions.question: What is 'Quantum Supremacy / Quantum Advantage'?
options: Demonstrating that a programmable quantum device can solve a problem faster than the best classical supercomputer
Replacing all silicon microprocessors in consumer smartphones with quantum chips
The complete obsolescence of classical computer programming languages
Achieving 100% wireless data transfer across interplanetary distances
